cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds a smartphone at chest height; a quiet indoor ice rink during an empty early-morning public session — she rests at the open rink gate; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing; her home kitchen with a counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; an empty art-deco cinema foyer after a retro costume screening — wearing a playful adult cinema-usher party costume she sits down to cool off and peels off the costume's detachable overskirt; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing with one foot up on a step; a fashion runway under white spotlights — sitting on the ground; the grand lobby and staircase of an opera house — brings a cocktail glass to her lips; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — perched on a ledge or edge; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds a small screwdriver at chest height
